basic_info.description: Tucked away on a quiet street in the sought-after Lake Shore neighborhood, this charming home boasts a well-designed floor plan with two bedrooms plus a versatile bonus space across two levels. The main floor features an inviting living room with a cozy wood-burning fireplace, a bright dining area, and a thoughtfully arranged kitchen. Two spacious bedrooms at the rear offer a peaceful retreat, with large windows overlooking the lush backyard.  The lower level expands the living space with a flexible bonus area perfect for a guest suite, home office, or additional lounge providing direct access to the beautifully landscaped garden. A generous garage offers parking and ample storage.  Ideally situated near top-rated schools, Stonestown, Stern Grove, freeways, and public transit, this home blends comfort, convenience, and timeless charm in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods.
